'''Praxon''' was a manufacturer of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="TOR" /> and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:RotHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>
